name: bq-formation
description: Examine company formation in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba for 2026. Use for Caribbean Netherlands NV and BV incorporation, notarial deeds, founder contributions, commercial registration, establishment permissions, island licence fees, ownership records and first-year accounts obligations. Distinguishes incorporation, permission to trade, immigration and tax status. Provides primary-source rules, hypothetical component positions and the evidence a professional reviewer needs. This source-cited reference retains gaps in the complete entity catalogue, local fees, officer rules and other registration streams. It cannot yet support a complete operational entity selection or formation package, or establish comprehensive country coverage.
